screen_name: App user list (with Add/Edit App User dialog)

Wired to nothing

Shows the Edit dialog with that row's values. The aria-label and title contain the unmasked phone number, defeating the masking for screen readers and DOM inspection

Close the dialog and discard typed input, no confirmation

actions.kind: Unbuilt scope (also on SCR-20) — export of citizen phone numbers is a data-protection decision
Unbuilt; with 3,123 users this is the only way to reach 99.7% of the data

validation.rule: Free text; substring match on the rendered (masked) row text; empty shows all rows; max 100 characters (same PROPOSED list-search limit as SCR-06/10/11/13; see OQ-21-12)
Closed set: 10, 25, 50 or 100, default 10; currently wired to nothing
Optional free text, trimmed; max 60 characters; Unicode letters, space, hyphen, apostrophe
validation.message: PROPOSED "First Name must be 60 characters or fewer."
PROPOSED "Last Name must be 60 characters or fewer."

validation.rule: Optional; if present must match ^\S+@\S+\.\S+$ (type="email"). Checked on blur only: not on Save and not in the Save-enabled test (the field carries none of data-req/data-pattern/data-min, which both checks scan), so an invalid email can be saved after the message appears (defect, OQ-21-08). Max 254 characters; unique among app users, case-insensitive (server-side)
validation.message: "Please enter a valid email address." / PROPOSED "Email must be 254 characters or fewer." / PROPOSED "An app user with this email already exists."

validation.rule: Required (trimmed); digits only ^[0-9]+$ (inputmode="numeric"). Min 7, max 15 digits (seed values are all 7 digits; the masking function assumes at least 4). Unique among app users (the de facto identifier; the Edit button is labelled by it; server-side)
validation.message: "Phone No is required." / "Phone No must be digits only." / PROPOSED "Phone No must be 7 to 15 digits." / PROPOSED "That phone number is already registered." (OQ-21-09)

validation.rule: Whole number, minimum 0 (declared), default 0; maximum 1,000,000 and integers only (no decimals). Empty or non-numeric saves as 0 (Number(v) \|\| 0)
validation.message: PROPOSED "Enter a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000."

validation.rule: Whole number, minimum 0 (declared), default 0; maximum 1,000,000; must not exceed Earner Points
validation.message: PROPOSED "Redeemed points cannot exceed earned points."

validation.rule: Whether an admin may edit points at all (they are normally derived from verified reports and redemptions)
Column with no field or data

All rows hidden, no message, footer unchanged. Undefined — OQ-21-06
Not reachable (no delete exists). Undefined — OQ-21-06

steps.text: I open App user List
the page loads
the footer reads "Showing 1 to 10 of 3,123 entries" and every Earner and Reedemed cell reads 0
row 1 shows ····567
I press its eye icon
the cell reads 1234567 and the icon's label becomes "Hide full phone number"
pressing again returns ····567

acceptance_criteria.title: Add dialog opens with Save disabled

steps.text: I press ＋ Add App User
the dialog appears
the title is "Add App User", Earner and Reedemed Points read 0, Phone No is empty and Save is disabled
the Add dialog is open
I type "12ab" into Phone No and tab away
"Phone No must be digits only." shows beneath it and Save stays disabled
replacing it with "8761234567" clears the message and enables Save
the Add dialog holds Phone "8761234567", First "Ann", Last "Lee"
I press Save
the dialog closes, an 11th row appears with the phone masked •••••••567 (seven dots for the ten digits, last three visible), and a toast reads "App user 8761234567 added successfully."
the footer reads "Showing 1 to 11 of 3,123 entries"
I press ✎ on row 1
the dialog opens
the title is "Edit App User", Phone No holds 1234567 and Save is enabled
the Edit dialog for row 1 is open
I set Earner Points to 50 and press Save
row 1 shows Earner Points 50 and the toast reads "App user 1234567 updated successfully."
every row's phone is masked again

acceptance_criteria.title: Search matches on visible text only

steps.text: the list is shown
I type "567" into Search app users
only row 1 stays visible
typing "1234567" shows no rows, because the text on screen is ····567
the list is shown
I press CSV, Excel, Print, page 2 or change "Show" to 50
nothing changes on screen (prototype behaviour to be replaced, see OQ-21-05, OQ-21-06)
